artworks.title: Je fis ce qu'on appelle un bon marché (I made what I would call a good bargain)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and softground etching (for the grainy texture in the lower left margin) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval market scene. There is a crowded marketplace with animals such as pigs walking around and a rider on a horse moving through the crowd. In the background, there is a large cathedral under a cloudy sky. Various items and vendors are visible, with goods on display. The border is decorated with sketches of figures, a horseman, and other motifs. The composition conveys the liveliness of historic European city markets.

artworks.title: A cette lueur soudaine... (In the sudden gleam of light...)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and softground etching (for the grainy texture in the sky) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene near a medieval castle gate. The image shows a tumultuous scene with animals such as cows and pigs running through a street, amidst a crowd of people who appear to be in disarray. The central focus is a fortified gate and towers of what appears to be a castle or town, under a swirling sky with smoke. The border of the drawing is adorned with intricate figures and patterns.

artworks.title: Le soir même... (The same evening...)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette in black on moderately thick cream wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group of people on a bridge with various surrounding sketches. The central scene shows figures on a bridge with a tower nearby. Some figures hold umbrellas, sticks, or musical instruments. The background has narrow paths bordered by vegetation. Above and around the scene are sketched figures and scenes that appear mythical or otherworldly, possibly angels or mythical creatures. In the lower part of the drawing, there are lively scenes with animals like frogs and human-like figures interacting with water elements.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Traitors; Dante's Foot Striking Bocca degli Abbate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract interpretation of a landscape with figures. The image depicts two cloaked figures standing on what appears to be the edge of a body of water, observing the scene. Within the water, there are portrayals of people struggling or floating with various expressions. The background features a rocky cliff with carved human forms and faces. The sky behind shades from light to dark, creating a dramatic tone.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Falsifiers; Dante and Virgil Covering their Noses because of the stench
artworks.description: This is a drawing with mountains, figures, and flames. The image shows towering mountains in the background. In the foreground, there are human-like figures intertwined. Two elongated, robed figures stand on a rocky outcrop. Swirling lines of smoke or flames add movement to the scene. The artwork has intricate details and a surreal atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; The Devils Tormenting Ciampolo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures engaged in a dramatic scene. The central figure is on the left, posed dramatically. To the right, a group of winged figures are interacting with the central figure. The background shows a turbulent sky with swirling clouds. The figures are depicted with detailed line work, musculature, and intense expressions. The setting appears rocky, possibly coastal, with hints of a body of water in the background.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Buoso Donati Attacked by the Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in a surreal landscape. The scene depicts two clothed figures on the left, an unclothed figure in the center, and another unclothed figure on the right. There are swirling clouds above, and an elongated dragon-like creature emanating smoke from its mouth towards the central figures. The background features stylized, pointed shapes suggesting a rocky or mountainous terrain. The lines are finely detailed, creating texture and depth in the figures and the landscape.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Agnolo Brunelleschi Attacked by a Six-Footed Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring humans and mythological creatures. In the foreground, there is a central figure with human and reptilian features, scales, horns, and an alarmed expression. On the left, two figures wrapped in robes observe with serious expressions. On the right, two nude figures react to the central figure. The setting is a rocky landscape with mythological creatures and vegetation.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; The Devils Mauling Each Other
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two winged figures flying above swirling waters. The drawing depicts two muscular, humanoid figures with wings engaged in flight. Below them, the water is depicted with swirling, circular lines. In the background, a landscape featuring enigmatic figures and faint outlines of mountains or hills can be seen.

artworks.title: The Peasant Dance
artworks.artist: Benoît Audran II after Antoine Watteau
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures dancing or gathering in a forest setting. The central figures include a woman and a man. The woman is standing elegantly with her head tilted downwards, wearing an intricate dress and styled hair. The man is dancing energetically, wearing a hat, a loose shirt, and knee-length trousers. Other figures are also present, including two seated men and a group in the background. The background is filled with trees and foliage, creating a natural woodland scene.

artworks.title: The Comte d'Artois and His Sister Mademoiselle Clotilde
artworks.description: The image depicts two young children in elaborate historical clothing. The child on the left is seated on a deer, wearing a dress with a bow around the neck and holding a basket of fruit. The child on the right stands beside the deer with one hand on its head, wearing an embroidered suit with a sash and breeches. Both children have neatly styled hair. The background shows a lush landscape with trees and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Duchesse de Nemours
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the knees up. She has one arm resting on an intricately carved armrest and the other arm on her lap. Her facial expression is gentle with a slight smile, and she has a prominent nose and full cheeks. Her hair is styled in soft curls and partially covered by a dark, lace-edged bonnet. She wears voluminous, luxurious clothing with lace trim at the cuffs, and a large draped shawl around her shoulders. The backdrop includes draped fabric, with a partially visible column with tassels on the right-hand side.

artworks.title: Spaccato interno della Basilica di S. Paolo fuori delle Mura
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the interior of a large basilica. It features a series of grand arches and towering columns along the main nave. The ceiling has visible beams, and the far end of the basilica has intricate artworks and statues within an arched apse. The walls are decorated with reliefs and panels. The floor space is open and spacious, with natural light coming in through a row of arched windows along the upper level.

artworks.title: Veduta del Ponte Salario
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an ancient stone bridge with arches and a fortified structure on top. The perspective is slightly elevated. The horizon is low with distant trees and landforms. The detailed brushstrokes depict stone textures and architecture realistically. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white. Figures and boats are near the water, and a structure or tower is visible in the distance among hills and trees.

artworks.title: Frontispiece, with Statue of Minerva
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring classical ruins and natural elements. The composition includes fragmented columns, statues, inscriptions, and a robed figure at the center. Foliage and trees are intertwined with the stonework, creating a blend of nature and architecture. The detailed linework adds texture to the materials depicted, with a monochrome palette emphasizing the contrast between the structures and organic growth.

artworks.title: Seated Figure
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her upper body leaning forward. She has wavy hair and is wearing a dress and a necklace. The background is plain.

artworks.title: David Slaying Goliath
artworks.description: A boy raises an oversized sword high over a man who has fallen face down as others fight in a landscape in this horizontal woodblock print. The scene is printed with three blocks, two in shades of olive green and the third in black. The cream-white of the paper creates the highlights. The boy kneels with one knee pressed between the shoulders of the fallen man. The boy wears a toga and lifts the sword with both hands. Much larger than the boy, the muscular man reaches one hand forward, the fingers raised. Beyond this pair and to the left, some men kneel with their hands held up and together toward others who hurl stones or a lance at soldiers to the right. A man carries a fluttering banner in front of tents in the background in the rightmost quarter of the image, and another armored man runs away from the action, toward us and to our right along the right edge of the sheet. There are trees and hills in the background under bands of clouds in the sky. An inscription was carved out of the bottom center of the pale olive-green block so white text reads, “RAPHAEL VRBINAS. P. VGO DACARPO.”

artworks.title: An Easter Calendar Beginning with the Year 1466
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in dark brown with hand coloring in yellow, ochre, green, rose, and brown on laid paper, with volvelle joined at center by a string
artworks.dimensions:
image: 18.8 x 13.8 cm (7 3/8 x 5 7/16 in.)
sheet: 21.3 x 16 cm (8 3/8 x 6 5/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Desert
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man from the waist up, kneeling in a forest setting. He has a long beard, a bald head with hair at the sides, and appears to be looking down or slightly to the side. The man's upper body is exposed, with a cloth draped over his lower body. He is next to a tree, with one hand grasping its trunk. A lion is sitting close by, facing the viewer. In the background, there is a castle or large building on a hill surrounded by trees and open countryside. The lines are bold and the details intricate, typical of a woodcut print.

artworks.title: The Young White King at the Butts
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 21.7 x 19.3 cm (8 9/16 x 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows four men outdoors. Three men are standing on the left, drawing bows and aiming arrows at a target on the right. They are dressed in period attire. The fourth man is on the right, standing and facing the archers. He has long hair and wears a fur-collared coat over a tunic, holding a large feather in his left hand. The background has trees and bushes with fluffy clouds in the sky. The target on the right has arrows in it. The foreground has grassy terrain, vegetation, stones, and a wooden fence.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Woman
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image portrays the sketch of a woman seated and reclined on a cushioned surface. She has long, wavy hair, delicate facial features, and wears a long dress with detailed sleeves and bodice. The woman is holding a small pouch or fan and wearing a necklace. The background is minimal, focusing on the seat's outline. The sketch is in sepia tones on light paper with a signature or inscription at the bottom edge.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.8 x 12.1 cm (7 13/16 x 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing. He is facing slightly to his left, with his left leg bent at the knee and his right hand holding a key with a cross-shaped top. The man has a halo around his head. He has rugged facial features with a prominent beard and long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a draped robe with layered fabric folding over his left arm and covering his entire body down to his feet. He wears sandals, and next to his left foot on the ground is a large, closed book. The background is plain with a small plant or bush depicted on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Cabinet d'un Peintre
artworks.description: The image shows an artist's studio interior. The room is filled with paintings in ornate frames and decorative carvings. In the center, multiple figures are engaged in creative and intellectual activities around a table with open books and sheets. Sculptures and a large curtain to the right decorate the room. The drawing is detailed and refined with intricate linework and precise depictions of elements.

artworks.title: Auti te Pape (Women at the River)
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstract figures set in a dream-like landscape. The image consists of two prominent figures situated in front of a textured and patterned background. The central figure is positioned seated, with distinctive features and an adorned head, depicted in dark tones contrasted against the lighter textured surroundings. To the right, another figure appears to be in motion with arms raised, contributing to a sense of movement and fluidity. The background exhibits abstract patterns that resemble geological or organic forms, creating a mystical and ethereal atmosphere. The contrast between light and dark areas is pronounced, enhancing the dramatic effect of the composition.
